about: Leonida Trophy Ledger: the official 55 trophies with a guide in the author's own words for each one. Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them. Four trophies whose unlock method was not confirmed at launch are marked not yet confirmed rather than guessed at.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. PowerPyx puts the whole road at about 200 hours and a 4/10 difficulty across a single playthrough — there is no difficulty setting, and free roam stays open after the story, so nothing here needs a second run.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission. It is the first thing the game asks you to do, so this pops within your first hour — just follow the objectives as they come.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. While you are here, do Lucia's first meditation on the balcony at Jason's house on the morning after 'Down to Earth' — see Positive Mental Attitude, the one trophy that can be missed.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its end. Kenton's shipwreck quests pause after Chapter 1 and return in Chapters 2 and 3, so pick them back up when they reappear.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3. This is the chapter where the map properly opens up — Andy's quests in Belville and the Snap Gun unlock both sit here, so start them while you pass through.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 4 to its end. The final mission, Starting From Zero, closes the chapter — and the story's last gold trophy with it.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission, Starting From Zero, at the end of Chapter 4. There is no mission replay in GTA VI, but the story itself is unmissable — just play it through to the credits.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. A story mission — follow the objectives as they come and it pops at the end.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. A story mission — play it through and it pops at the end.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play in Chapter 4. A story mission — play it through and it pops at the end.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners in Chapter 4. A story mission — play it through and it pops at the end.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. A story mission — play it through and it pops at the end.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. A story mission — play it through and it pops at the end.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. PowerPyx's checklist: 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 300 stunts, all robberies, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Note that 100% here is closer to 60% true completion — most side quests are not required, so do not chase everything.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights and 25 Base Jumps. 100% completion needs 300, so the trophy comes first if you chase stunts early — mix jump types as you travel and the count climbs on its own.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: Fishing, Hunting, Golf, Shooting Ranges, Pool, Basketball, Video Game, a race (a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race) and a Stunt. One try of each is enough — you do not have to win or finish anything.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 range locations. Learn each range's weapon and par time, then gold them one by one — a range you have already visited stays open in free roam, so there is no rush.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations (42 races in total). A win at each location is what counts, not all 42 races — so visit all 14 spots and take one win at each.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across the 40 unique race locations. Street races count — vary the location each time and the wins stack up over a completion run.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the 9 activity types — find Cal's challenge and out-fish him. It is a one-off challenge, not a grind.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. There are 4 video games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind on the home TV, and Bang For Your Buck at arcade machines. Finish all levels of any one of them once.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission. Andy (Lucia, Chapter 3, Belville) has 5 quests: Climbing the Cellerichain 1–3, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. Work through them in order in the cleanup stage.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission. Kenton (Chapter 1, Key Lento, marked 'KR') has 7 shipwreck treasure sets; he is temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2–3, so finish his sets in the cleanup stage.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. Billy's 5 quests open after the Chapter 2 Coffee Break at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Which strands count is still being mapped — PowerPyx names Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries) among them, and notes that Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward this one, so do not waste time on those six here.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. Randy opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys (Makin' GS): 16 sports cars on his wishlist, tracked under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List, using the Key Cloner.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. Tyrone is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: destroy the Synthetic Labs, then Spin On This.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot: 18 spots across 10 locations. This is the ONLY trophy that can be missed — the first meditation, Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house on the morning after 'Down to Earth' in Chapter 1, disappears after Chapter 1, and PowerPyx notes it is unconfirmed whether that one meditation is required (its author had done it when the trophy popped). Do it in Chapter 1 to be safe. Meditating with both characters at one spot counts +2. Track them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations; 100% completion needs 15 of 18.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel (Jason-only, after the Chapter 2 Coffee Break, Lummox County) gives hunting quests and the unique rifle 'Killtelligence SM-69'; he also has 15 Target Decks to work through.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are a collectible strand spread across Leonida — work through the sets and finish any 3 of them.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations across Leonida — Landmarks, Curiosities and Sculptures all count (No Flusher Tags). Scan with the WAiNK app: D-pad Up, then R1. Sweep locations as you travel and the count climbs on its own.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges run through the whole game, and 100% completion needs 70 of 80, so 50 comes well before the end of a completion run — just play and they accumulate.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. It needs partner free-roam (after the Chapter 2 Coffee Break): call your partner with D-pad Right + Triangle, build 4 stars, then break the line of sight — the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is the easy route. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…'.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Easiest at the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (after Chapter 3, Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs). The pop is delayed about 30 seconds after you leave the third shop, so do not panic if it does not fire at once.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scan with the WAiNK app (D-pad Up, then R1); there are 557 vehicles at launch, and 200 base models are needed for 100% completion, so this one pops early on the way there.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is L3+R3 while aiming, and the focus bar is purple, top left. Buff it with food or Adrenaline and try it against a gang operation — PowerPyx notes it does not work on soldiers, police or civilians, so pick your targets.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: steal a large passenger plane docked at a VCIA departure terminal (E3/E4 are the easiest), get into the cockpit upstairs and fly 1 km away.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Tanks (Rhinos) sit at Mile Zero Air Station in Mariana County, on the south-west island. Climb into one and shoot until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. You need the Snap Gun, unlocked after the Chapter 3 Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: enter through the backdoor with the Snap Gun, find the safe-code note and loot the safe. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds is the suggested target.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. It opens after the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' (tail a security van and the vault opens). 8 large bank jobs exist in total — any 5 count for the trophy and all 8 for 100% completion. Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000 after his earlier quests.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Either the mission that unlocks it, or sticky-bomb an armored truck's back door and escape the heat radius.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — unfog the whole map (52 areas per the PSN target). A plane is the fastest way to sweep it, so take one up and cover the state in passes.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. 39 illegal operations exist in total — 1 per gang is enough for the trophy, all 39 for 100% completion.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED — no unlock method is confirmed at launch. PowerPyx, OutputLag and KeenGamer all list this one as unknown, so do not chase rumours about it; check the cited guides again after launch-week updates before spending time on it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City and drive it through the window. You need the Key Cloner (Chapter 3, Clonin' Keys). A nod to GTA III.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley in Port Gellhorn (a gang operation): steal all 3 key valuables — the luxury watch, the 'Gutterball Moreland 850' shotgun and the office safe (sticky bombs) — then escape the police. It can be done across repeat visits, so take what you can each time.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Max out strength with Jason AND Lucia at the same time. Work out together — call your partner and use the fitness clubs, which are filterable on the map. Both characters must be at max together for the pop.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make 500 choices that move your Criminal Profile (Professional / Hardened / Violent / Psycho / Irredeemable — Irredeemable is permanent, so avoid it). Turn on Criminal Profile HUD notifications to watch the count climb as you play.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED — no unlock method is confirmed at launch. PowerPyx believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue, but that is a belief, not a confirmed method. Do not grind the store on a rumour; wait for a confirmed report.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED — no unlock method is confirmed at launch. The belief is that it comes from a UFO questline, but no source confirms it yet. Check the cited guides again after launch-week updates.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED — no unlock method is confirmed at launch. The belief is that it comes from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle, but no source confirms it yet. Check the cited guides again after launch-week updates.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. After the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Dye Pack Jammer), launder the marked bills at a fence — Yasmani pays the most. The total is cumulative, and bank vaults give up to $205,000 in one robbery, so vaults are the fastest source.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way through it — buy what you will use anyway and the total climbs without waste.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties: 8 purchasable garages (4 more are story-related), $160,000 in total, through the Vice City Real Estate phone app after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app opens after the Chapter 2 mission with Moses; register stolen vehicles at Moses in Port Gellhorn ('Respray' then 'Register'). Garages add parking spots, and cheap cars and bikes keep the costs low.
trophies.name: On the Spot
